tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Checks a domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX and TLS, blacklists, website and age, the way Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft judge a sender. Returns a setup score out of 100, a readiness verdict, and each problem with how to fix it. Also accepts a public IPv4 address (blacklists and reverse DNS).

tools.name: generate_records
tools.description: Returns the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records the domain should publish, based on the providers it already uses, each marked add, replace, keep or configure, with the reason.
